notes.title: Gauntlet of Power Patch 4: The Temple and the Rogue
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/9856238/0b247cbcf9759b91fa6e46431fc13a77875890ed.jpg[/img]

The new update for Heroes of Loot: Gauntlet of Power is now live! 

[h1]New Content:[/h1]

– Hidden realm: The Temple
– New unlockable character: The Rogue
– New friendlies
– New enemies

Grab the update now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2374320/Heroes_Of__Loot_Gauntlet_Of_Power/

[h2]More info:[/h2]

Besides adding the new realm and characters, I made some small changes to balancing things out (especially for the easy mode).

I also made the realms more of a choice to go into or not, as it will mean you now skip one or two levels. So if you are in a hurry and want to speedrun the game, knowing where to find the entries to these realms is certainly key.. but I can imagine it might sometimes be more interesting to NOT take the realm-route and grab some extra loot in the levels you would otherwise skip.

If you need a little spoiler on how/where to find the Rogue unlock tokens, make sure to check the Orangepixel website for the Games Wiki.

notes.title: Update 3.0.1: Graphics enhancements
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.orangepixel.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/mailing_heroesoflootsteam.png[/img]

This is a small but important update, as it should fix most (all?) of the graphical artifacts some people might have. 

If you had black or white stripes appearing on the screen, they should now be gone!

On a side note, work on the sequel has also begun, so make sure to check [url]www.heroesofloot.com[/url] and sign up to the news letter to stay updated! 

The plan is to make the game better in every way: more interesting quests, bigger variation in characters (and play with all 4 characters under your control!) and a lot more.. so stay tuned

notes.title: update 2.2.0 - resolution and volume settings
notes.notes:
I just pushed update 2.2.0, it adds an improved option menu.

By popular demand, you can now change the music and sound effects volume. Also more control over the size of the window (if not fullscreen).

Further a bunch of interface improvements pushed.

Let me know in the comments or on the forum if you run into issues!

notes.title: Version 2.1.2 - Auto-fire bug fixed
notes.notes:
Just a minor update, I finally found the cause of the auto-fire triggering for keyboard players. This happened after you, accidentally, moved the mouse for a bit, which we all know happens pretty often in the heat of the battle!

Also fixed the max-dungeon achievement unlocking for pre-Steam players.

notes.title: Version 2.1.1 - Logitech F310 support, achievements and hitbox fixes
notes.notes:
The new update fixes the problem with Logitech F310 controllers and their mixed up directions ;)

There's also a small update making achievements unlock for those players who had the pre-Steam release.

And finally some improvements to the hit-boxes of the Cyclops, Minotaur, and Summoner (the purple guy).
